title: Jets injury update: Joseph Ossai is off the physically unable to perform list

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets injury update: Joseph Ossai is off the physically unable to perform list
sources.description: The Jets have activated defensive end Joseph Ossai from the physically unable to perform (PUP) list. Ossai (6-4, 263) was placed on the Active/PUP list on July 28. He signed with the Jets in March after playing his first four seasons with the Cincinnati Bengals. During his time with the Bengals from 2022-25, Ossai played […]
